## Activity

During May 2021, East City Eye Clinic completed 136 captures. This activity provides the basis for the monthly review of image quality and grading performance. The reported volume should be considered alongside the number of images available for assessment and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

There were 2 ungradable captures during the month. The ungradable rate was 1.5 per cent. This indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and record any recurring camera issues with the service desk. Timely reporting will support investigation and help maintain consistent capture standards.

## Grading

A total of 22 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. These results should continue to be reviewed through routine service monitoring, with attention to any changes in referral volumes or grading timeliness. The monthly figures provide a clear summary of activity, image quality and grading outcomes for East City Eye Clinic.
